final_topology.title: Financial Data Ingestion Network
final_topology.description: A network designed for ingesting financial data feeds and processing them in dedicated market data pods, with outputs distributed to three campus sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network includes dedicated pods for data ingestion and processing, connected to three campus sites via trunk links for inter-site communication. Segmentation is enforced by function.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an Asset Management System (n22 and n29) that manages various nodes, indicating an inventory of assets.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes numerous data flow links (e.g., nl_new1, nl_new2, etc.) and zone links (e.g., zl_new1, zl_new2, etc.), indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different functions (e.g., Ingestion Pod, Market Data Pod, Campus Sites, Management Zone, Security Zone, etc.), indicating segmentation based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Firewall (n11) that manages data flows to various nodes, indicating the implementation of a firewall on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Server (n12) that provides DNS services to various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5), indicating the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Server (n13) that manages MFA for various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5), indicating the requirement of MFA for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Filtering Server (n14) that provides DNS filtering services to various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5), indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Web Proxy (n15) that manages web traffic for various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5), indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones (e.g., Ingestion Pod, Market Data Pod, Campus Sites, Management Zone, Security Zone, etc.) and links that enforce segmentation, least privilege, and availability, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Central AAA Server (n16) and other security-related nodes (e.g., n11, n14, n15, n17, n18, n19, n20) that manage network infrastructure securely, indicating secure management practices.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Central AAA Server (n16) that manages AAA for various nodes (e.g., n11, n23, n24, n25), indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN Gateway (n23) that manages remote device connections (n24, n25) to the Central AAA Server (n16), indicating the use of a VPN and connection to the AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n17) that monitors network traffic and sends alerts to a SIEM (n18), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Firewall (n11) that manages data flows between different zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6), indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an Access Control Manager (n26) that manages access control for remote devices (n24, n25), indicating managed access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Log Collector (n27) that collects logs from the Firewall (n11) and NIDS (n17), indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for Production (z11) and Non-Production (z12) systems, indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Host (n21) and a Penetration Testing Service (n28) that perform external penetration tests, indicating the performance of periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of a detailed and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets, including their network addresses, hardware addresses, machine names, asset owners, and departments.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a detailed asset inventory.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system or include labels on nodes indicating asset details.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: There is a Central AAA Server (n16) and an MFA/Identity Server (n13), but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and connections from remote devices to the AAA infrastructure.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: There is a Central AAA Server (n16) and an MFA/Identity Server (n13), but there is no explicit evidence of managing access control for remote assets based on specific criteria.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of managing access control for remote assets.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes or links that explicitly show access control management for remote assets.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: There is a SIEM (n18) that is connected to the NIDS (n17), but there is no explicit evidence of collecting network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of collecting network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a log collection system and links to network devices.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: There is a Penetration Testing Host (n21) in the External Testing Zone (z9), but there is no explicit evidence of performing periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of performing periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to the penetration testing host.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No asset management system or process is explicitly shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes to indicate asset tracking.

findings_before.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show separation between production and non-production systems.
findings_before.missing_reason: No distinct zones or nodes are labeled as production or non-production.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add distinct zones or nodes labeled as production and non-production, and ensure they are separated in the topology.
